**Cover letter (Monzo – Junior Product Designer)**

Dear Monzo hiring team,

While I am new to formal design roles, I taught myself Figma and applied it to a personal project: an AI‑powered mobile app that helps users discover personalized music playlists based on their mood. Building this app allowed me to practice end‑to‑end design—research, wireframing, prototyping, and iterative testing. I particularly enjoyed integrating user feedback into rapid design sprints and seeing a product evolve from concept to a polished prototype.

I am eager to bring my customer‑first perspective and self‑directed learning to Monzo’s design team. I look forward to shaping delightful user experiences for your growing bank.
